description:
Epiphany puts your markets, your money and your city on one screen.

Markets: stocks, crypto and commodities with clear charts and the news behind each move.
Portfolio: net worth, holdings, budget, debt payoff and goals, synced from your brokerage if you want.
Situation: a live map of what is happening near you, from earthquakes and wildfires to traffic and flights overhead.

Brokerage links are read-only by default. Nothing is traded unless you turn trading on.
